findings.description: Pierre Albert Tullier and Constance Dorothé Leys had a son, Pierre Jacques Dominique Tuilier, born 1796 and married 1825 in Bambecque, France, in addition to their five children already in the tree (born 1805-1816).

target_person.name: Pierre Jacques Dominique Tuilier
target_person.marriage: 21 June 1825, Bambecque, Nord, France, to Constance Victoire Depuydt
